facts.value: You will receive a digital language certificate indicating your language level according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR), recognized by the International Office and Global Office of Goethe University.
This certificate is issued in two languages (German and English).
This language certificate can also be used for your application abroad or later during your job search.
You will receive your grades via email approximately 4-5 weeks after the exam date.
For elective module courses and Master's courses: Your grades can be viewed password-protected in QIS.
